overall: The AG found the Board's November 18, 2020 executive session purpose (complaints against a Housing Authority chair) had concluded, so the minutes must be released within 30 days, subject to privilege or Public Records exemptions; the Board's untimeliness defense was rejected.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board must release minutes of a November 18, 2020 executive session because the original purpose for the session had concluded.
allegations.key_passage: As the purpose for the executive session that took place on November 18, 2020, has concluded, the minutes of the executive session can no longer be withheld from the public under the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Within 30 days of receipt of the letter, release the November 18, 2020 executive session minutes and any documents or exhibits used at that session, unless the attorney-client privilege or a Public Records Law exemption permits withholding in whole or in part.
remedy_passage: We order the Board, within 30 days of receipt of this letter, to release the minutes of the November 18, 2020, executive session and any documents or exhibits used during the executive session, unless the attorney-client privilege or an exemption to the Public Records Law permits the Board to withhold the minutes, either in whole or in part.
